properties.name: The v0.26.0 version bump in reflow2.toml. `design_holds` because a version string carries no design meaning — the design meaning of a cut lives in rel:v0260 and epoch:v0260, not here. Accepted BEFORE release_includes_all is applied, deliberately: the manifest freezes each artifact's current checksum as shipped, and doing it the other way round freezes the pre-bump value and costs a second export (the v0.20.0 lesson).
